description: This file contains shell script functions to configure, initialize, and manage VXLAN networking protocols in a OpenWrt environment, including setup/teardown procedures, configuration parsing, and peer management.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup_peer
methods.description: Sets up a VXLAN peer based on configuration parameters, adding a forwarding database entry.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_setup
methods.description: Configures VXLAN tunnel parameters and updates networking state accordingly.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup
methods.description: Initializes VXLAN configuration with IP and peer address, initiating the setup process.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_setup
methods.description: Initializes VXLAN IPv6 configuration with address and peer address.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for VXLAN IPv6 teardown logic.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_init_config
methods.description: Defines the common configuration parameters for VXLAN protocols.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters specific to VXLAN.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters specific to VXLAN over IPv6.
